item.title: Clene ALS Treatment and Gold
item.description:
• Summary: Clene Nanomedicine's CNM-Au8, a gold nanocrystal therapy for ALS, is under scrutiny. STAT News questions whether the treatment works, highlighting conflicting trial data on slowing disease progression.
  • MoAs: Gold nanocrystals that enhance cellular NAD+ levels, improve mitochondrial function, and reduce oxidative stress
  • Sources: STAT News
